assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE wide cinematic narrative illustration for La Piràmide, a real cooperative game for coworkers. Reference image is only the physical tabletop game terminal design; preserve its shape, buttons and colors. Scene: two adult coworkers, a curly-haired woman in a dark teal casual shirt and a man in a warm neutral shirt, standing together at one small table. The woman has noticed something on the terminal and points at it naturally; the man looks at the same thing with an expression of understanding. Their shared gaze and natural human gestures must make 'one person finds a clue and another helps make sense of it' immediately legible. Medium shot waist up, faces and hands clearly visible, terminal modest size in foreground, all fully within frame. Polished mature illustrated videogame cinematic art, semi-realistic painterly 3D, grounded modern everyday clothing, warm expressive faces. Landscape 1536x1024. Background deep graphite #0A1016, soft cyan rimlight #39D6E5, restrained magenta accents #DC68A7, warm ivory highlights; edges of vignette dissolve into clean dark graphite with generous space around subjects. No office branding, no text, no letters, no arrows, no diagram, no invented symbolic puzzle, no holograms, no floating panels, no fantasy technology, no presentation slide. The result should show a human moment of shared discovery, not a schematic.
